youtube.description: YouTube server for searching videos, getting transcripts, and fetching comments

weather.description: Handles weather information queries. Use this server for queries about current weather, forecasts, or weather conditions for a specific location.

slack.description: Handles Slack integration, listening to messages in Slack channels and routing them to the appropriate agent or tool. Use this server for queries about Slack communication, automation, or bot interactions.

playwright.description: Handles browser automation and web scraping using Playwright. Use this server for queries that require automated browsing, data extraction, or web testing.

service_system.description: Handles all customer support, troubleshooting, and resolution for Adobe product issues, including software crashes, errors, and how-to questions. Use this server for queries about support cases, their status, summaries, and resolutions.

sales_system.description: Comprehensive Dynamics 365 Sales system handling leads, opportunities, quotes, campaigns, and organizations. Use this server for all sales-related queries including lead management, opportunity pipeline analysis, quote processing, sales forecasting, campaign tracking, and account management with product entitlements.

web_search_scrape_rag.description: Intelligent web search with scraping and RAG. Use this server for any general queries that require web search and analysis. e.g., What is the latest news about AI??

microsoft_docs.description: Official Microsoft Docs MCP Server with semantic search against Microsoft official technical documentation. Provides real-time access to Microsoft Learn, Azure documentation, Microsoft 365 documentation, and other official Microsoft sources. Performs semantic search and returns up to 10 high-quality content chunks with article titles, URLs, and self-contained content excerpts.

content_analysis.description: Handles basic content analysis, including metadata extraction and structure analysis. Use this server for queries about content analysis.
